title: Transcription
description: On-device speech-to-text output for a single audio clip. Emitted by backend.core._runtime.audio.transcribe(). Gemma 4 E2B audio supports clips up to 30s; longer clips must be chunked upstream.

audio_source.description: Local path or http(s) URL that was passed to the processor. The raw audio is never stored here — only the reference.

transcript.description: The transcribed text in the audio's original language. Whitespace-trimmed; no trailing newlines.

language.description: ISO 639-1 / BCP-47 code if known (e.g. 'en', 'fa'). Null when the caller did not declare and the model did not return a language tag.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length if measured by the caller. Null when unknown.

model_id.description: Hugging Face model id used for transcription (e.g. 'google/gemma-4-E2B-it').

instruction.description: The text instruction sent alongside the audio. Useful for debugging when output drifts.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when this transcription was produced.
